A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a system that has been shown to be effective for the learning of biomedical knowledge, and for the learning of problem solving skills.

problem based learning is an approach to medical learning which emphasizes problem solving, self-directed learning, and small group learning in the context of a clinical problem, rather than the traditional lecture based learning in which the student is the passive recipient of information.
problem based learning is an approach to medical and health science education in which the emphasis is on the problem solving skills of students rather than on their memory skills.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the problem based learning approach to medical education is not only a more effective approach to medical learning, it is a more efficient approach, and it produces a more effective physician.
problem based learning is not a single, well-defined method, but a family of approaches that share a set of common features.
